note: Every case runs in its own sandbox seeded with seed.ndjson (40 rows). A case that declares extraSeed is additionally seeded with paging-rows.ndjson (85 more rows), so only that case's ledger holds 125 transactions; q01 counts the 40 seed rows alone. No question states an answer: each states the shape its answer takes and which reading of the ledger settles it, and src/suites/query/derive.ts asks oled itself, once, in a throwaway sandbox seeded the same way, before any run starts.

cases.prompt: How many transactions are recorded in my ledger in total? Answer with the whole number in `value`.
Counting only my THB accounts, what is my net worth (assets minus liabilities)? Do not convert my other currencies into THB. Answer with the amount in `value` and its currency code in `unit`.
How many grocery transactions were recorded in May 2026? Count transactions, not days or shops. Answer with the whole number in `value`.
What did I spend at restaurants in May 2026, in THB? Restaurants only: not groceries and not coffee. Answer with the amount in `value` and its currency code in `unit`.

What is the total of all my THB expenses in May 2026, as one number? Expenses only: exclude card payments and transfers between my own accounts. Answer with the amount in `value` and its currency code in `unit`.
What is the current balance of my KBank bank account, in THB? Answer with the amount in `value` and its currency code in `unit`.
How much salary income was received in May 2026, in THB? Answer with the amount in `value` and its currency code in `unit`.
Across the whole ledger, what is the total amount I have spent at the merchant Grab? Answer with the amount in `value` and its currency code in `unit`.

Which single merchant did I spend the largest total amount at in May 2026? Rank merchants by total amount spent, not by number of transactions. Put the name by itself in `answer`, with no sentence around it.

Taking restaurants, groceries and coffee together as food: how much more did I spend on food in May 2026 than in April 2026? Give the difference itself, not the two totals it came from. Answer with the amount in `value` and its currency code in `unit`.
In May 2026, how many coffee purchases were for strictly more than 100 THB? A purchase of exactly 100 THB does not count. Answer with the whole number in `value`.

Give me one single number for everything I spent in May 2026 across all my accounts, counting every expense category. If one number is not meaningful here, say so and give the per-currency totals instead.
